slides.title: THE QUICK TEST
slides.note: Ionic bonds transfer electrons. Covalent bonds share them.

slides.title: IONIC
steps: Na is a metal, Cl is a nonmetal
Na gives up 1 electron to Cl

slides.title: COVALENT
steps: H and O are both nonmetals
O shares electrons with each H

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Ionic compounds are made of molecules
points: Ionic compounds form a crystal lattice. The formula shows the simplest ratio of ions.
